_comment: Build-time list of public, indexable salon profiles for sitemap.xml generation (seo §7). Each entry yields an /s/:slug URL. `lastmod` is an optional W3C date (YYYY-MM-DD); when omitted the build date is used. Populate this from the salon API/export at release time — new salons are not indexable until the next build (see design 'Public-route prerender' caveat).
